Name: Combat Equipment Plus
Author: AgusIV
Description:
[font=Tahoma][color=#e06666][size=6]This is a Json Assets mod!
[/size][/color][/font][color=#e06666]You will need Json Assets and all of its dependencies.[/color]



[font=Tahoma][color=#f4f4f4][size=6][b][u][center]The Weapons﻿[/center][/u][/b][/size][/color][/font]     This mod adds 15 new weapons (daggers, swords and clubs), some of them are obtained combining a weapon with another one (or a vanilla item) in the Ginger Island forge, which leads to this, new to Stardew Valley, Terraria-like progression.

[b][size=5]STATS:[/size][/b]
[b][u]Syringe (dagger):[/u][/b] 7-10 Damage / +2 Speed / +2 Crit Chance / +4 Weight
[u][b]Blacksmith's Mace (club):[/b][/u][b] [/b]12-20 Damage / -1 Speed / +5 Weight
[u][b]Signed Handle (sword):[/b][/u][b] [/b]14-20 Damage / +6 Weight
[b][u]Broken Ruby Dagger (dagger):[/u] [/b]8-12 Damage / +1 Speed / +5 Crit Chance
[b][u]Signed Blade (sword):[/u][/b] 26-36 Damage / +3 Speed
[u][b]Frying Pan (club):[/b][/u] 12-20 Damage / -3 Speed / +5 Crit Chance / +25 Weight
[u][b]Dormant Obsidian Club (club):[/b][/u] 40-45 Damage / +3 Crit Chance / +5 Weight
[u][b]Gambler's Dagger (dagger):[/b][/u] 1-50 Damage / +5 Crit Chance / +100 Crit Power
[u][b]Red Beauty (dagger):[/b][/u] 28-40 Damage / +4 Speed / +5 Crit Chance / +150 Crit power
[u][b]Excalibur (sword):[/b][/u] 80-100 Damage / +2 Speed
[u][b]Fiery Obsidian Club (club):[/b][/u] 89-105 Damage / +1 Speed / +4 Crit Chance / +5 Weight
[u][b]Awoken Excalibur (sword):[/b][/u] 90-100 Damage / +2 Speed / +5 Crit Chance / +5 Weight
[u][b]Fiery Dragonhammer (club):[/b][/u] 100-125 Damage / +4 Defense / +4 Crit Chance / +5 Weight
[u][b]Infinity Dragonhammer (club):[/b][/u] 125-140 Damage / +2 Speed / +4 Defense / +4 Crit Chance / +5 Weight
[u][b]Historic Blade of Infinity (sword):[/b][/u] 110-125 Damage / +3 Speed / +4 Defense / +5 Crit Chance

                                         [color=#f4f4f4][img]https://i.ibb.co/pRWbXRF/Swords-Mod.jpg[/img][/color]

     (please note that the level doesn't mean that a weapon it's better than the other in any way, that happens because in Stardew Valley the level of the weapons is automatically generated)


[size=6][b]                                               [u]The Boots[/u][/b][/size]

     As a bonus, I also decided to include 6 different pairs of shoes, which you can get in different parts of the whole Stardew Valley.

[b][size=5]STATS:[/size][/b]
[u][b]Willy's Fisherman Boots:[/b][/u] +1 Defense / +2 Immunity
[u][b]Mouse Paws:[/b][/u] +3 Defense
[u][b]McQueen Crocs:[/b][/u] +6 Immunity
[u][b]Dragonclown Boots:[/b][/u] +1 Defense / +11 Immunity
[u][b]Island Boots:[/b][/u] +9 Defense / +3 Immunity
[u][b]Infinity Boots:[/b][/u] +12 Defense / +12 Immunity
